feeds.title: Reading the Past
feeds.description: News, views, and reviews on historical fiction, both new and old / by Sarah Johnson. Reading the Past is my home on the web for historical fiction, and I use this space for writing about historical novels and discussing the genre with my fellow readers.

feeds.title: A Writer of History » Reading Historical Fiction
feeds.description: A Writer of History is a place to talk about all aspects of historical fiction. Here you will find interviews with top authors and debut authors, results of my reader surveys, musings on being a writer, research on the era I'm writing about, and thoughts on the books I read.

feeds.title: Historical Britain Blog
feeds.description: In this blog Mercedes Rochelle talks everything about Historical Fiction.

feeds.title: English Historical Fiction Authors
feeds.description: English Historical Fiction Authors, bringing you daily posts about all aspects of British History. British history posts by authors of British historical fiction.

feeds.title: Al-Alhambra Book Reviews Blog
feeds.description: I'm a fantasy/historical fiction book lover. I love reading worlds with anti-heroes and heroes that are seeking redemption. I also like the immense world-building and a story where you quickly sympathize with the main character. This blog is meant for books in the fantasy genre that are not given enough attention, have a different diverse cast of characters, and relates to non-European Fantasy fiction.

feeds.title: Bookish Elf » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Bookish Elf shares everything about historical fiction, a genre with a historical setting that attempts to convey the spirit, manners, and social conditions of a bygone era with realism. The Bookish Elf is all about the passion for books and reading, knowledge, and perception. We are a small group of readers who want the world to know what we read and what they should read.

feeds.title: Fictionophile » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Lynne and here I share the historical fiction books I have read and would like to recommend to you. Nothing gives me so much pleasure as recommending a title(s) or series, then hearing back from someone that they read it and enjoyed it. I love how my blog allows me to connect with another book 'nerds' and other book bloggers and readers around the world.

feeds.title: Jill's Book Blog » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Jill, in this section, shares historical fiction book reviews. I am a writer in Toronto, Ontario. I review six books a week and I also post blog memes daily! I have studied English, publishing, and creative writing. I also have my Masters's in Creative and Critical Writing from the University of Gloucestershire. I am currently querying agents with my contemporary young adult novel about a Princess in England. I am writing a young adult fantasy novel!

feeds.title: Literary Titan » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Literary Titan is here to connect readers with the best historical fiction books, author interviews, news, and more. The Literary Titan is an organization of professional editors, writers, and professors that have a passion for the written word. We review fiction and non-fiction books in many different genres, as well as to conduct author interviews, and recognize talented authors with our Literary Book Award.

feeds.title: The Book Review Directory » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Read posts about Historical Fiction Reviews written by Book Review Directory. The Book Review Directory is about doing three things - getting your book reviewed, finding you a great book to read, and helping book review bloggers find readers.

feeds.title: Booklover Book Reviews » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Australian book reviewer sharing views on her historical fiction reading. Hi! I'm Jo. Since starting this website in 2009 I've come to realize I enjoy writing about books almost as much as reading them, and Booklover Book Reviews has become a much-valued creative outlet for me.

feeds.title: The History Reader Blog
feeds.description: A History Blog by @StMartinsPress, offering articles, interviews, and further reading for history buffs and book lovers everywhere, from ancient times to today.

feeds.title: Armed with A Book » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Armed with A Book through this segment is bringing the hidden and known gems of the book from the world of Historical Fiction to you! Written by Kriti, an avid reader, you will find book reviews, author interviews, creative conversations as well as buddy reads here.

feeds.title: Review Tales » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Review Tales is a book magazine, that publishes articles containing book reviews and recommendations on historical fiction. Jeyran Main is the founder and Editor-in-chief of Review Tales Publishing & Editing Services and Review Tales Magazine. Jeyran is also a professional book reviewer. Her passion is to spread positive energy to anyone who needs it, and in return, she would love it if they forwarded it to someone else.

feeds.title: The Reading Cafe » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: The following section of The Reading Cafe is about Historical Fiction. Find your next best read! At The Reading Cafe- There are two of us who started this site, as a means to express our love of all things pertaining to books. Whether it be a review, an author or model interview, a fun post, or anything that is informative.

feeds.title: LitBuzz » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Looking to read Historical Fiction? Stay tuned with LitBuzz to find your next best read. LitBuzz is a fun venture by a bunch of bibliophiles who love discovering new and fun authors and sharing them with the world. We have a diverse interest base, so the variety of books you find here will always be exciting and we will always be looking for more! Author interviews and exclusives, giveaways, and news about the books you can't wait to read.

feeds.title: The Historical Fiction Company Blog
feeds.description: Covers author spotlights, book reviews, book trailers, podcast interviews, book blog tours, writing tips, and ramblings about historical fiction.The Historical Fiction Company is an exclusive online bookshop for Historical Fiction, and online community / social network for Historical Fiction authors and readers.

feeds.title: Historical Fiction Blog
feeds.description: Born and raised in St. Louis MO, Mercedes Rochelle graduated with a BA in English Literature from the University of Missouri. She learned about living history as a re-enactor and has been enamored with historical fiction ever since. This site is dedicated to Historical Fiction Indie Writers who work so tirelessly to spread their vision.

feeds.title: Seattle Book Mama » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Seattle Book Mama is your place to stay connected to and read reviews on the historical fiction genre. My name is Donna Davis, and I am a retired teacher. This blog has provided me the chance to read and review excellent literature before it hits the stores, and so I am delightfully busy with the printed word. My purpose in creating this blog is to share books about the things, people, and events that affect everyday people the most, both fictionally and in nonfiction, across a wide array of genres.

feeds.title: The Chocolate Lady's Book Review Blog » Historical
feeds.description: Follow and read posts about historical fiction written by Davida Chazan. If you're looking for the next great read, or you've heard of a book I've read and you want to know if you should read it too, you are the person I'm writing this blog for.

feeds.title: The Historical Writers Association
feeds.description: Our passion is history. We are authors, publishers and agents of historical writing, both fiction and non-fiction, and we have created this Association to provide professional and social support to our members, and to create opportunities online and in person for our members to meet with readers, fellow writers and enthusiasts for all things historical.

feeds.title: History from a Woman's Perspective
feeds.description: My intent of this blog is to show history from a different perspective, a woman's. These books that I am going to review are about women in historical eras. These are both nonfiction and fiction and can fit into any genre: historical, YA, mystery, fantasy, etc.

feeds.title: Historical Fiction Reader
feeds.description: Historical Fiction Reader is a book review blog that specializes in history based fiction and nonfiction. I accept review inquiries for historical fiction and any all related subgenres. This includes traditional historicals, historical fantasy, historical romance, time-slip novels, alternative history, etc.

feeds.title: Caz's Reading Room
feeds.description: Fiction of a historical nature and anything else that takes my fancy. Avid reader and prolific reviewer of historical romance and fiction in book and audiobook formats.

feeds.title: Plodding through the Presidents Blog
feeds.description: Humorous and historic stories from my trek to read a biography of every US president in order.

feeds.title: HerStory Novels
feeds.description: On this site you will find lists of historical fiction by women and about women, as well as reviews of books I have read and enjoyed, and occasional author interviews. I include books that put women and girls front and center. I emphasize classic and literary historical fiction written for adults, and steer away from historical romances or mysteries.

feeds.title: Novel PASTimes
feeds.description: Blog about all things related to historical fiction. Our blog has been around since 2005. You will find some fun interviews with characters from some of your favorite historical novels, along with This Day in History, a sprinkling of book reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Sepia Tinted Window
feeds.description: I'm Ffion, a twenty-something from the UK with a passion for all things historical fiction! Although I read a variety of genres, I'm always drawn to historical fiction more than any other, and it's certainly my favourite genre to write. This blog will include reviews of historical fiction books I've recently read, and also snippets of interesting historical facts I've picked up whilst researching for my novels.

feeds.title: The Whispering Bookworm
feeds.description: The Whispering Bookworm reviews and spotlights historical fiction by both traditionally published and independently published authors.

feeds.title: KATHERINE P. STILLERMAN
feeds.description: Kathy Stillerman's historical fiction novels are character-driven, historically accurate, realistic, and always hopeful with strong female protagonists.

feeds.title: Blog
feeds.description: Clyve Rose has been writing historical romance fiction for the best part of two decades. She works in the historical romance, fantasy, and speculative fiction genres. Read the latest juicy news from Clyve Rose, award-winning author of historical, sexual fantasy, and paranormal romance. Free mini-reads on her blog.

feeds.title: The Intrepid Reader
feeds.description: Marg blogs about books and food with particular emphasis on historical fiction and Australian authors, and cake!.

feeds.title: DIGGING INTO THE PAST Blog
feeds.description: A history lover's dive into blogging. Authored by Susan, a writer and reader of historical fiction.

feeds.title: Historical Fiction reviews
feeds.description: A lifelong interest in history and a love of reading eventually led Paul to Wayne State University where he majored in Ancient History, with a minor in Physical Anthropology. The Mallory Saga is the culmination of Paul's love of history, and his creative drive to write stories. With Nightwish and Bruce Cockburn coming through his headphones, and many cups of excellent coffee, Paul hopes to carry the Saga into the late 19th century, bringing American history to life through the eyes and actions of the Mallory family.

feeds.title: In Another Era
feeds.description: Welcome to In Another Era, my historical fiction book blog! My name is Annelies and I'm a twenty-something from Belgium. I love to read historical fiction and I am fascinated by medieval Europe, especially stories about England, Italy, France, and Russia. On this blog, I want to share my love for books, history, and writing.

feeds.title: M J Porter Blog
feeds.description: I'm an author of fantasy (Viking age/dragon-themed) and historical fiction (Early English, Vikings and the British Isles as a whole before the Norman Conquest), born in the old Mercian kingdom at some point since the end of 1066. Raised in the shadow of a strange little building and told from a very young age that it housed the bones of long-dead kings of Mercia, it's little wonder that my curiosity in the early English ran riot.

feeds.title: Historical Editorial
feeds.description: I'm Jennifer Quinlan. I founded Historical Editorial in 2011, and since then I've edited nearly 400 manuscripts and designed over 200 book covers. I love historical fiction! I edit across all of its subgenres, including romance, mystery, inspirational, fantasy, supernatural, time travel, steampunk, gay/lesbian, and young adult.

feeds.title: The Freelance History Writer Notes and Reviews
feeds.description: This blog is a companion to my main blog The Freelance History Writer and will be for notes, news, and book reviews. Books reviewed here are non-fiction and ones I read for my personal enrichment.

feeds.title: Bookliterati Book Reviews » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Find, follow and read historical fiction book reviews by Bookliterati Book Reviews. This blog is your place to stay connected to the best books; read reviews from various genres.

feeds.title: Simply Love Book Reviews » Historical
feeds.description: Simply Love Book Reviews publishes a great collection of historical romance reviews to add to your TBR. Reviewing books about love of all kinds, we are a group of friends from all walks of life with a common love of books. We read all things romance. However, we do not discriminate, if it sounds good to us we will read it. Take a look at our reviews, hopefully, you will find something of interest.

feeds.title: Toby A. Smith
feeds.description: I am spending more time in the world of books, photography, and ideas and, when I can, feeding my passion for travel. My website/blog focuses on my own independent book reviews. You'll see I am particularly drawn to historical fiction and my favorite topics are English, French, and Russian history and the two world wars.

feeds.title: Shellie Loves Books
feeds.description: Book reviews featuring history, historical fiction, and mysteries as well as all the thoughts on all things bookish. Shellie is a Texas teacher who loves to read and find out what others are reading and book reviews really help her to decide what to read.

feeds.title: The Coffee Pot Book Club
feeds.description: The Coffee Pot Book Club blog specialises in promoting historical fiction (generic historical fiction, historical romance, mystery, time travel / dual-timeline, historical fantasy, and non-fiction). It also hosts our annual Book of the Year Awards, offers quality editorial reviews, and curates 'Book of the Week / Month' features to help authors reach a wider audience through reader-affinity networks.

feeds.title: She's Becoming Bookish
feeds.description: She's Becoming Bookish, a book-focused website where Carlie shares all things books, diving deeper into her personal opinions, thoughts, and feelings about the books she reads. It is a fun way to be creative and share thoughts about her newly rediscovered love of reading.

feeds.title: Elisabeth Storrs Blog
feeds.description: In Ancient Rome banquets were held in a triclinium where philosophy, literature and art were discussed along with intrigue and scandal. feeds.title: Writing the Renaissance

feeds.description: The Paper Lantern Writers, an author collective, specializes in historical fiction spanning epochs and locales worldwide. With tales ranging from romance to tragedy, they invite readers on captivating journeys through time, offering to be their insightful guides.

feeds.title: Sophie Perinot Blog

feeds.title: Reading Ladies » Historical Fiction

feeds.title: Janet's Writing Blog
feeds.description: Janet Morrison's Writing Blog is a personal blog where the author, Janet, writes about Southern historical fiction and local history. She is currently working on two novels set in Virginia and the Carolinas in the 1760s. Her weekly blog is about her journey as a writer and a reader. In her blog, she shares her thoughts on the books she has read, including both fiction and non-fiction.

feeds.title: History Through Fiction Blog
feeds.description: The History Through Fiction blog is a place where the independent historical-fiction press shares: author interviews, book spotlights, writing-and-research essays, short-story contest news, and deep dives into history behind fictional stories.

feeds.title: Anne Gracie Blog
feeds.description: Anne Gracie, author of Regency-era historical romance. Contains writing advice and useful links. Find out the latest news and information about Regency historical romance author Anne Gracie from her official blog.

feeds.title: Paul Jariabek's Historical Fiction Blog
feeds.description: Explore historical fiction essays and immersive articles for history enthusiasts.

feeds.title: Books'n'Stuff ~ Between the Lines » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: The Historical Fiction section of Between the Lines Book Blog by Cathy Ryan features book reviews, spotlight features, and guest posts on a variety of historical-fiction titles, ranging from cozy mysteries to supernatural and dual-timeline novels.

feeds.title: Historical-Fiction.com
feeds.description: Historical-Fiction.com is a book review blog focusing on the genre of historical fiction. Featuring over 150 reviews, book news, author guest posts and giveaways, Historical-Fiction.com proudly hosts original content and a wide range of titles, new and old.

feeds.title: Historical Novels Society
feeds.description: A guide to historical novels and authors of historical and western fiction; books organized by setting, with information on literary style and genre.

feeds.title: Austenprose
feeds.description: Join the celebration of Jane Austen novels, movies, sequels and the pop culture she has inspired

feeds.title: One Book More » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Read historical fiction books synopsis, and in-depth detailed reviews by One Book More on their blog. Hi there! I'm Julie, and literature is my passion. I love to read, talk, and write about books. Classics, contemporary, fantasy, romance, young adult, sci-fi, poetry - they all rock! I started this blog, and now I can share my love of reading with other book-lovers.

feeds.title: Literary Quicksand » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: The following section of Literary Quicksand publishes articles on Historical Fiction. Hi! Welcome to Literary Quicksand. We're a book blog based out of Minneapolis, MN. We feature a group of women writers from multiple countries who all come together over one thing: our love of books! We regularly post book reviews, book lists, TBR roundups, and more.

feeds.title: Let Them Read Books
feeds.description: A book blog specializing in historical fiction, romance, and fantasy. . I mostly feature historical fiction and romance on this blog, but you can see all of my reviews on Goodreads.

feeds.title: History and Women
feeds.description: History and Women is dedicated to writing biographicals of women in history and also some of the latest and best historical fiction releases. We work closely with authors and publishers to help spread the word about fascinating women and some of the latest releases of women's fiction and women's biographical fiction.

feeds.title: Discovering Diamonds
feeds.description: I decided to open this review blog because I am passionate about assisting good indie and self-published authors of historical fiction to get noticed, I am also a keen reader of the historical novel and have written a few of my own - both indie and traditional mainstream.

feeds.title: Reading the Ages
feeds.description: Preferred genres are historic fiction and non-fiction, historical and foreign country mysteries with early and late Medieval of particular interest to me. I read voraciously and review books as a hobby and do not receive compensation for reviews.

feeds.title: Historical Fiction eBooks
feeds.description: The Historical Fiction Authors Cooperative (HFAC) is an international group of authors who first teamed up in 2010 to offer readers a selection of high-quality historical fiction e-books.

feeds.title: Historical Readings and Reviews
feeds.description: Historical fiction and history book reviews, upcoming releases, ebook deals, and more. I love all things history and genealogy, if I'm not researching my genealogy in my spare time, I'm usually reading a historical novel or history book.

feeds.title: Past and Present Reads
feeds.description: A place to discover novels that alternate between the past and present (and other books you might love).

feeds.title: Clarissa Harwood Blog
feeds.description: Clarissa was born and raised on the Canadian prairies. Clarissa writes historical fiction set mainly in Victorian and Edwardian England. She has been fascinated by all things Victorian since she was a child. Her novels pay homage to her favourite Victorian authors: the Brontë sisters, George Eliot, Thomas Hardy, and Frances Hodgson Burnett.

feeds.title: U.S. Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Follow to get updates from U.S. Historical Fiction.

feeds.title: historywithatwist
feeds.description: I'm no historian, but I do like the subject (I even managed to get an Honours degree in it after much sweat and tears). I also like to write historical fiction. The idea is to collate interesting snippets from the past, things which spark an interest and maybe even a story or two.

feeds.title: The Cozy Book Blog » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Reviews & discussions for reading enthusiasts on historical fiction are shared by The Cozy Book Blog in this segment. My name is Diane-Lyn, and I am an avid reader with a passion for writing. What's a better way to get the best of both worlds than starting a book review & discussion blog? If you want to get a good 'feel' for book themes, characters, plots, or just want to participate in discussions on your favorite reads, then you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Jenny Knipfer Blog
feeds.description: Historical fiction author, Jenny Knipfer, shares her books, inspiration, thoughts on life and writing, and book reviews. Purchase Jenny's books, read her blog or listen to encouraging podcasts highlighting the life of a writer on her website.

feeds.title: MMB Book Blog » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Read books reviews on Historical Fiction in this segment by MMB Book Blog. Welcome to my blog! I'm Jen, mama, writer, and bookworm. I started my first blog, Mighty Mama Bear, back in 2017 so talk about our adventures as a family of five. After my family, my second love is books and so I created this blog, Mighty Mama Bear's Book Blog. Here you'll find reviews, roundups, and quotes for both adults and children.

feeds.title: Two Nerdy History Girls
feeds.description: One of us - Loretta Chase -- writes historical romance. One of us -- Susan Holloway Scott --writes historical novels, and as Isabella Bradford, also writes historical romance. We talk about who's wearing what and who's sleeping with whom. We try to sort out rumor or myth from fact. We thought there must be at least three other people out there who think history's fascinating and fun, too. This blog is for them.

feeds.title: Kim Pink Writer Blog
feeds.description: Writings and Readings by Kim Pink. Good historical fiction books. For the stories that bring to life the historical women who challenged convention.

feeds.title: I've Read This » historical fiction
feeds.description: I've Read This brings historical fiction book reviews for genre-interested bookworms in the following section. My name is Anne Logan, and like you, I adore reading books. I started this blog in 2013, a place where I post my reviews of recently released books.

feeds.title: Book Frolic » Historical Fiction
feeds.description: Book Frolic shares book reviews and recommendations for Historical Fiction in this segment of the blog. I'm Stephanie, a book lover. I've been into books since I was a child when my mom would take me to the local library almost every afternoon. My love of books continued through my teenage years and took a bit of a nosedive during college (when you're forced to read specific books, it takes the fun out of it), but I'm now back to reading as often as I can.

feeds.title: Word Wenches
feeds.description: Eight historical authors plotting the present and writing about the past and improvising the rest.

feeds.title: Novelhistorian
feeds.description: To me, a historical novel describes settings, events, and conditions at least fifty years old, though I'll bend that to suit my interest in the late Sixties and the Vietnam War, the era I came of age. I avoid sagas, and I won't review novels that mix the past and present.

feeds.title: A Darn Good Read
feeds.description: Historical fiction book reviews and random musings. I read historical fiction and its sub-genres spanning the times of William the Conqueror and World War II; occasionally, I stray out of my timeline.

feeds.title: Magic of History | Book Reviews
feeds.description: A place to learn about history and historical fiction, including period pieces in books, films,(movies) videos, TV, and on the web. Magic of History is a website to help you learn more about history and historical fiction in books, films, videos and websites.
